args.title: Summary: Ironbark returns logistics post + companion piece
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.ironbark.example/2026/returns and its companion piece (https://insights.ironbark.example/returns/companion):

- Apparel return rates reached 24%, highlighting the scale of the retail returns challenge.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth (~20%).
- Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
